sources.title: USDA FSIS — Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart
sources.what: All poultry (incl. ground poultry, giblets, stuffing) 165°F; ground meats 160°F; beef/pork/veal/lamb steaks, chops, roasts 145°F + rest ≥3 min; fresh/ham uncooked 145°F + rest. Used as the only numeric food-safety claims in the two new guides.

sources.title: USDA FSIS — Food Thermometers
sources.what: A food thermometer is 'the only reliable way' to confirm safe minimum internal temperature; whole poultry checked in three places (innermost thigh, innermost wing, thickest breast), avoid bone; do not stuff whole poultry for optimum safety; stuffing centre must reach 165°F.
